title: The Biggest Food Fight In The World
description:
La Tomatina is a Spanish festival in Buñol where participants throw tomatoes at each other, the biggest food fight in the world. It started on the last Wednesday of August 1945 when, at a parade of giants and big-head figures, a participant's big head fell off and he began hitting everything in his path; a vegetable stall fell victim and people started pelting each other with tomatoes until the local forces ended it. The next year young people brought tomatoes from home, and the yearly tradition began. Until 2013 there was no limit on participants; since then it has been ticketed for no more than 20,000 people, in a town of about 9,000.

Source: Wikipedia, 'La Tomatina'.
